And his word was pleasing in the eyes of the little {OCR?}.
[The things] that were revealed in this time: {OCR?}
When Muhammad was small of stature, his father 'Abdallah died,
and his uncle Abu Talib brought him up.
And he took for himself a wife, a widow whose name was Khadijah,
because she was rich in possessions.
And with her wealth and with her camels he used to trade,
and go up from Yathrib (the city {OCR?} of his city) to Palestine.
And when he saw that the land of Palestine was rich in good things,
and became acquainted with certain Jews,
and learned from them that through the confession of one God and the rejection of the worship of idols, God gave them that land of promise,
he too desired this,
and began to persuade his countrymen concerning this,
when he was forty years of age.
And when this was heard by the leaders of Mecca,
namely that he was bringing forth a strange confession among them,
they persecuted him and threatened him with death if he did not desist from this.
He, however, fled from there and went to another city whose name was Yathrib.
And those Medinans went out to meet him and welcomed him,
and promised to help him in everything.
And from here they were called Ansar, that is, Helpers.
And he taught them the confession of one God,
and that they should abandon vain gods.
And he urged them concerning bodily purity and washing,
because the Arabs were exceedingly filthy at that time.
And he made for himself bands of them,
and sent raiding parties to Palestine.
And when at times he went with them,
and they were victorious and returned in peace, laden with wealth and property,
they cleaved to him with all their heart.
And many others also, when they heard of the victory and wealth,
submitted to him without trouble.
And when those who were with him multiplied,
he no longer went up in person to plunder,
but sent others at the head of his forces,
while he himself sat in honor.
